blurb: Stone Spring Farms is a beautiful wedding & events venue located in Berks County, PA. It is nestled in among open fields and at the foot of the Appalachian Mountains. The grounds have a natural, country charm that hosts flower fields, ponds, scenic views and most importantly - a spacious and newly renovated historic barn.
